payload.answer: But is leftover question still a thing anyway? All questions seem to be resolved when relevant, and only study remain?

options.description: No more "N questions for you" at turn end. The line still says when your answer was applied and whether the turn's checks pass. Leftover questions are still counted on your band and at the session start, and they're asked through the question tool.
options.label: Drop the count (Recommended)

options.description: The turn ends with no plumb line at all. You'd learn about applied answers and passing or failing checks only from your band, the status card or the agent's reply. A behaviour that stops working would no longer be named at turn end.
options.label: Drop the whole line

options.description: Keep the count, but say what to do with it ("…; I'll ask it next" or "…in the study room"). This reverses the earlier choice to keep it a bare count.
options.label: Keep it, say where

payload.question: At the end of a turn, plumb prints one line such as "plumb: 1 question for you". Questions now reach you through the question tool, and your band and the session start already count what waits. What should happen to that line?
